about: THE BADLANDS HIGHWAY (route R9, One World BUILD_PLAN phase 4.2, 2026-11-17): the city's highway south over the scrub and the badlands to the Circus, the Desert's way in from Disaster City (EXIT 1: the link downtown_desert's Desert end, which stood on the retired Highway's room). The design page: 'the chain gas station, a motel, billboards (Exit 1)'. The old Highway's rest stop (the city chain's gas station), its LAST GAS billboard and its city-limit sign moved here. Its own room: the Circus is a district of another tool and joining it would make 27 plots in one straight row. THE RAISED HIGHWAY (2026-11-22, mondo: 'actual highway architecture, raised off the ground with exits and stuff'): `raised` lifts the road onto ramps and a deck on pillars 7 m up with one exit (ow-raised.js); six plots were added beside it (`add`) so the gas station (west) and the motel (east) stand on ground of their own beside the exit's ramps, and the road under the deck runs on past both walls.
